title: It’s like my grounding technique but instead of panic attacks it’s fo...
transcript: Today is World Suicide Prevention Day. And as somebody who has been suicidal in the past, I have found that the best way for me to stay alive is to constantly have reasons for living. And so here are five of my current reasons for living that I just have to remind myself when I'm feeling at my darkest. 1 there's always new and exciting theatre to see. Right now I have to stay alive to go see the American cast of Benjamin Button in October and the Broadway transfer of Paddington next year. But there's also long term fantasies that I have to be around to see when they happen, like the inevitable legally blonde revival and the Encores! production of Diana the musical that you know is going to happen in like 20 years that I I need to still be around for. If people like Donald Trump and Scott Rudin get to outlive me, I'm gonna be fucking pissed. So you better believe I'm sticking around out of sheer spite. Why die when I could just go get a bowl of ice cream, which, I don't know, that always sounds good? I have seen firsthand what suicide has done to my family. And I know that even me at my worst, even me reaching out and needing help, would never, ever, ever cause them as much pain as me no longer existing on this planet. And I would never want to cause them that much pain. I promised my friend I would watch her dog So we're sticking around. We're sticking around for this guy.
